item.title: Hour 3 – TNF Preview, Nick Wright
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes look forward to tonight’s matchup between the Bears and Seahawks. Plus, Nick Wright stops by to lament the loss by his Kansas City Chiefs and argue with DP about Larry Bird vs. LeBron James.

item.title: Hour 2 – Ross Tucker, Best and Worst
item.description:
NFL insider Ross Tucker drops by to break down Week 8 of the NFL season. And the Danettes present their best and worst of the weekend.

item.title: Hour 3 – Bird Killers, Overshadowed Tuesday
item.description:
After Fritzy encountered a dying bird in the parking lot this morning, DP and the Danettes talk about some famous killers of birds. Plus, they discuss which NFL players had strong performances that might not have made it onto your radar.

item.title: Hour 2 – Raiders Shouldn’t Trade Kirk Cousins, Devin McCourty
item.description:
As the NFL trade deadline approaches, Dan thinks the Raiders should be wary of trading Kirk Cousins despite several teams who are desperate for a quarterback. And NFL insider Devin McCourty drops by to weigh in on Week 8 of the NFL season.

item.title: Hour 1 – The Bears Look Like They’re for Real, Gerald McCoy
item.description:
There were some technical difficulties in the Man Cave this morning as Dan and the Danettes weigh in on the Bears big win over the Seahawks last night. And those technical difficulties crept in as DP talks to NFL insider Gerald McCoy about Week 8 of the NFL in the second segment.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Great Playoff Runs, Brady Quinn
item.description:
Dan continues to defend Dirk Nowitski’s NBA Championship run as one of the greatest in the history of sports. And Host of FOX TV’s Big Noon Kickoff and FOX Sports Radio Network’s 2 Pros and a Cup of Joe, Brady Quinn drops by to break down the initial College Football Playoff rankings.

item.title: Hour 2 – Jerry Jones Talking Nonsense, Bill Cowher
item.description:
DP and the Danettes react to Cowboys’ owner Jerry Jones latest tirade and wonder if he has any idea what he’s talking about. Plus, former NFL HC and Super Bowl Champion Bill Cowher stops by to talk some NFL.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – CFP Rankings Reaction, NFL Trade Deadline Approaching
item.description:
DP says the College Football Playoff Committee got exactly what they wanted after they released their initial rankings; everybody is talking about college football. And DP runs down some likely trade scenarios as the NFL trade deadline is next week.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Bill Hader, Nikola Jokić at It Again
item.description:
Dan interviews Actor Bill Hader about his new movie, “The Cat in the Hat,” and what it was like having his father for a football and basketball coach. And Nikola Jokić had his 90th game with a triple-double before reaching the fourth quarter so Dan talks about the evolution of NBA players.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Jacksonville Deserve Recognition, Malachi Toney Goes Down
item.description:
DP is finally ready to talk about the Jacksonville Jaguars as a real contender in the AFC. Plus, he weighs in on the injury to Miami Hurricanes star WR and Heisman contender Malachi Toney’s injury and what it means for the Heisman race.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 - NFL Injury Epidemic, Vincent Goodwill
item.description:
Lamar Jackson is on the shelf again, leaving Dan to figure out how the Ravens are going to survive without him. Add that to the season-ending injuries to guys like Jalen Hurts, Jack Campbell and other stars, and Dan understands why players don't want to wait to get the biggest contracts they can get. Dan talks to NBA insider Vincent Goodwill about Larry Bird, LeBron James, Dirk Nowitzki and the 2011 Dallas Mavericks, Victor Wembanyama and the Lakers being too dependent on Luka.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: HOUR 3 – Could Derrick Henry be on the move, Jacksonville has a quiet luxury
item.description:
With Jacoby Brissett bolstering the Ravens, Dan wonders if Baltimore might still be in play as sellers at the deadline. What will happen with Jonathan Taylor? Plus, while most people haven’t really embraced the Jaguars as AFC contenders just yet, they do have one giant advantage in the form of a player on their defense.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: HOUR 2 – Kobe was more feared than Lebron, Charles Davis
item.description:
A crime most foul strikes the Man Cave and an investigation is launched when nobody comes forward. Dan examines the difference in generational greats in basketball. CBS college football analyst Charles Davis joins Dan to discuss the initial College Football Playoff rankings, what has to shake out for the rest of the college football season and why the SEC is probably getting too much benefit of the doubt.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: HOUR 1 – Jaguars deserve more respect in the NFL, Grant Hill
item.description:
Dan reacts to the Thursday night showdown as the Jaguars roll the Ravens minus Lamar Jackson, but they’ve been so consistently good that it deserves attention. Hall of Fame basketball player and NBA on NBC analyst Grant Hill joins Dan to dish on ongoings in the NBA, comparisons of Lebron versus Larry Bird and memories of playing in the old Boston Garden.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: HOUR 3 - CFP Thoughts, Mark Schlereth
item.description:
In this hour of The Dan Patrick Show, Dan breaks down the official details of the 24-team College Football Playoff. Also, Dan and crew size up Shedeur Sanders' performance in an overtime loss to the Saints. Later, NFL broadcaster Mark Schlereth joins the show to react to everything that went down in Week 9. 

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: HOUR 2 – Monday Night Football, CFP Expansion
item.description:
Dan & the Danette’s do a quick preview of Monday Night Football between the Bills and Vikings, Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty is beginning to look more and more like a bust, ESPN and the College Football Playoff officially agree to expand the playoff field to 24 teams beginning next season, and more!

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: HOUR 1 – Officiating Controversy, Chase Daniel
item.description:
Dan Patrick & the Danette’s are back after an exhilarating weekend in college football and the NFL! Thoughts on the no touchdown call in the Miami – Notre Dame game, Michigan moving on from their offensive coordinator, how good the Rams really are, CJ Stroud’s big season so far and what it means for his contract negotiations, Chase Daniel joins the show, and more!

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.title: Hour 3 – Albert Breer, Overshadowed Tuesday
item.description:
NFL insider Albert Breer joins the show as the NFL trade deadline is only hours away. Plus, DP and the Danettes consider the most overlooked performances from Week 9 of this NFL season.

item.title: Hour 2 – NFL Trade Deadline Looming, Louis Riddick
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes dig deep into the NFL, and which teams should be active before today’s trade deadline. And NFL insider Louis Riddick stops in with all the info you need on which teams are looking to improve, and which are having fire sales.

item.title: Hour 1 – The Artist Formerly Known as Carson Wentz, Rece Davis
item.description:
The Vikings tried to plug in Carson Wentz into their starting QB slot last night against the Bills and it did not go well with Wentz managing the worst passer rating so far this season in the NFL. And CFP insider Rece Davis drops by to break down the highly anticipated move to a 24-team College Football Playoff.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.title: Hour 3 – Jay Glazer, Teammates No Longer
item.description:
With the NFL trade deadline behind us, FOX Sports NFL Insider Jay Glazer stopped by to review the trades that were (and weren't) made. Plus, DP and the Danettes address the tension on the court as Jaylen Brown and Jayson Tatum face each other as opponents for the first time since Brown got traded.

item.title: Hour 2 – Kirk Cousins Back in Minnesota, I Play Rocky
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes dig deep into all the story lines surrounding Kirk Cousins being traded back to the Vikings. And DP highly recommends watching “I Play Rocky,” and they discuss the legend of Sylvester Stallone and Rocky Balboa.

item.title: Hour 1 – NFL Trade Deadline, Kyler Murray Career Change?
item.description:
DP and the Danettes react to all the action from yesterday’s NFL trade deadline. And they wonder if Kyler Murray still has an opportunity to pursue a career in Major League Baseball.

item.title: Hour 3 – TNF Preview, Kurt Warner
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes preview tonight’s Thursday Night Football matchup between the Giants and Commanders. Plus, Hall of Fame QB Kurt Warner drops by to talk about his career and some of the best receivers he ever played with.

item.title: Hour 2 – RIP Dan Hicks, NIL Spending Is Unsustainable
item.description:
Dan talks about legendary broadcaster Dan Hicks who passed away at the age of 64. And DP thinks we are only going to have more issues with transfers and NIL spending as the landscape of college football is changing before our very eyes.

item.title: Hour 1 – Todd Monken Deserves Coach of the Year Consideration, Sports Emmy Aspirations
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes talk about the NFL Coach of the Year odds and DP throws Todd Monken’s hat in the ring considering the low expectations for the Browns at the beginning of the season. Plus, they consider the chances they could finally win that coveted Sports Emmy.

item.title: Hour 3 – Brief Stardom or Character Actor Longevity, Notre Dame QBs Struggle in the NFL
item.description:
Fresh of their conversation with John Turturro, Dan and the Danettes discuss whether it’d be better to be a long-standing character actor or to get a big role. It’s been a long time since a Notre Dame quarterback won a game in the NFL, and Dan reveals who it was.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.title: Hour 2 – Sam Hartman Is Your Next Bachelor, John Turturo
item.description:
With former Notre Dame QB Sam Hartman set to appear on the Bachelor, DP and the Danettes talk some Irish football. Actor and filmmaker John Turturro joins Dan to talk about his love for sports, moving to a big lead role in his new film, and his life working in character acting.

item.title: Hour 1 – Jayden Daniels Isn’t Superhuman, Jameis Winston Let the Dogs Out
item.description:
The Washington Commanders get a big win on Thursday Night Football, but Dan thinks the team needs to do a better job surrounding Jayden Daniels with talent. Jameis Winston shows off a new cadence at the line of scrimmage.
